# Bundled browser dependencies

These files are stored locally so Interview Chameleon can run without an internet connection.

| Package | Version | License | Project |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Alpine.js | 3.16.1 | MIT | https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine |
| Tabler Icons Webfont | 3.44.0 | MIT | https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons |
| MediaPipe Tasks Vision | 1.0.1 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe |

The two MediaPipe model files are the official Face Landmarker float16 v1 and Pose Landmarker Lite float16 v1 assets. They execute locally in the browser; camera frames are not uploaded by this application.
